awards.label: Best Overall
awards.why: A GE Cync in-wall paddle with built-in Wi-Fi for remote and voice control, for about $17.

awards.label: Best No-Wiring Option
awards.why: Sticks to any wall and runs about two years on its battery, but only controls Cync smart lights.

awards.label: Best Local-Only
awards.why: Pure Bluetooth control with no router or hub needed, and two circuits in one gang.

products.verdict: A normal in-wall smart switch that uses Bluetooth alongside Wi-Fi. Wi-Fi handles remote access and voice control.
pros: Built-in Wi-Fi for control away from home
Schedules and scenes in the Cync app
cons: Needs a neutral and a ground wire
Only 1 left in stock at capture time
Spec table lists a 2 A rating

specs.controls: Cync smart bulbs, strips, switches, plugs

products.verdict: A stick-on dimmer for Cync smart bulbs and light strips. It doesn't switch power to a fixture, so it only makes sense if you use Cync lights.
pros: No wiring, sticks to any wall
Replaceable battery rated for over two years
Pair with another Cync switch for multi-location control
cons: Only controls Cync and C by GE smart devices
Doesn't cut power to a regular fixture
Only 10 left in stock at capture time

products.verdict: A Wi-Fi switch with a Bluetooth fallback, so you can still control it from your phone when Wi-Fi is down.
pros: Bluetooth control when Wi-Fi is unavailable
Physical push button instead of a touch panel
cons: Runs on the cloud-based Smart Life app

products.verdict: The only true Bluetooth wall switch we found. It controls two circuits locally and adds remote and voice features with Hauza's hub.
pros: Local Bluetooth control with no router or hub
Two independent circuits in one gang
Multi-location control by associating switches in the app
Works with LED loads down to 5 W
cons: Remote access, voice, and schedules need the Hauza hub
